decks.notes: The deck focuses on using Niv-Mizzet Reborn's ability to cast multiple spells of different colors to gain card advantage and control the board. It includes a variety of multicolored spells and lands to ensure a diverse range of options when casting Bring to Light. The inclusion of cards like Leyline Binding and Vanishing Verse helps deal with opponent's threats, while powerful cards like Lightning Helix provide a mix of removal and burn damage. The deck aims to outvalue opponents through efficient spell casting and control the game until victory.

This Gruul Aggro deck aims to overwhelm opponents with fast, efficient creatures and burn spells. With a low mana curve and cards like Monastery Swiftspear and Soul-Scar Mage, the deck focuses on dealing damage quickly and efficiently. Blossoming Defense and Kumano Faces Kakkazan provide protection and removal options, while cards like Light Up the Stage and Audacity help maintain card advantage. The land base is optimized for consistent mana production, ensuring the deck can consistently apply pressure and close out games before opponents can stabilize.

The primary strategy of this Mono Black Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's hand and board with cards like Thoughtseize, Fatal Push, and Reckoner Bankbuster. The deck aims to maintain control of the game by utilizing powerful creatures like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Graveyard Trespasser, while also applying pressure with aggression from creatures like Tinybones, the Pickpocket and Gifted Aetherborn. With a focus on resource denial and efficient removal, the deck seeks to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent to secure victory.

This Golgari Aggro deck focuses on utilizing low-cost creatures with powerful abilities to quickly overwhelm the opponent and maintain board control. By utilizing cards like Tyvar, Jubilant Brawler and Priest of Forgotten Gods, along with removal spells like Fatal Push and Insidious Roots, the deck aims to apply continuous pressure and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck also includes graveyard recursion with cards like Scrapheap Scrounger and Moss-Pit Skeleton to ensure a steady stream of threats. With a mix of creature aggression and strategic resource management, this deck aims to dominate the battlefield and secure victory.

The deck focuses on fast and aggressive play, utilizing creatures with haste and burn spells to overwhelm the opponent quickly. The inclusion of Jegantha as a companion allows for additional mana acceleration. The deck also features protection spells like Blossoming Defense to keep key creatures alive. The mana base is optimized for efficient casting of spells, with a mix of lands that can produce both red and green mana. Overall, the deck aims to deal damage early and maintain pressure on the opponent until victory is achieved.

The main concept of this Aggro Gruul deck is to quickly flood the board with low-cost creatures and spells that deal direct damage to the opponent, creating a fast and aggressive playstyle. It focuses on utilizing cards like Monastery Swiftspear and Burning-Tree Emissary to apply early pressure while also having burn spells like Stoke the Flames and Play with Fire to finish off the opponent. The combination of creatures and direct damage spells aims to overwhelm the opponent before they can stabilize, ultimately leading to a swift victory.

The deck is centered around utilizing Niv-Mizzet Reborn as a powerful control finisher, capable of drawing cards and dealing damage to the opponent's board. The deck also includes a range of multicolor cards and Bring to Light to ensure consistency in casting spells. Additionally, the inclusion of Leyline Binding, Vanishing Verse, and Pillage the Bog provides removal options to control the opponent's threats. The companion, Yorion, Sky Nomad, serves as a value engine to generate card advantage and provide additional flexibility in gameplay. Overall, the deck focuses on control through card advantage, removal, and versatile threats.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on fast-paced aggression and disruption. It combines creatures like Bloodtithe Harvester and Vein Ripper with removal spells like Fatal Push and Heartless Act to control the board and push damage through. Additionally, cards like Sorin, Imperious Bloodlord and Preacher of the Schism provide additional value and synergy with your creatures. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly while disrupting their game plan with targeted discard spells like Duress and Thoughtseize. With a mix of efficient threats and disruption, this deck aims to close out games before the opponent can stabilize.

This deck focuses on controlling the opponent's board and hand while ramping up mana to cast powerful multicolor spells. The inclusion of Niv-Mizzet Reborn allows for card advantage and flexibility in spell selection. Leyline Binding and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker help to control the opponent's resources, while Omnath, Locus of Creation provides a win condition through its powerful abilities. The deck also includes a variety of removal spells and versatile cards like Bring to Light and Yorion, Sky Nomad to adapt to different matchups. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue the opponent and control the game until it can secure a victory.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells. It aims to control the board early with removal like Fatal Push and Bonecrusher Giant, while applying pressure with fast creatures like Bloodtithe Harvester and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger. Cards like Fiery Temper and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker provide additional reach to finish off the opponent. The deck also includes disruptive cards like Graveyard Trespasser and Thoughtseize to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Overall, the deck aims to be fast, efficient, and versatile in dealing damage.

The deck focuses on aggressively attacking the opponent with low-cost creatures and using cards like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy. Sorin, Imperious Bloodlord provides additional creature support and buffing capabilities, while Vein Ripper and Archfiend of the Dross offer powerful finishers. The deck aims to apply constant pressure and force the opponent to react defensively, allowing for quick and decisive victories. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Duress and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker helps maintain card advantage and disrupt the opponent's hand.

This Gruul Aggro deck focuses on utilizing low-cost creatures and spells to quickly deal damage to the opponent while also protecting its own creatures. With a mix of creatures with prowess abilities and direct damage spells, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with aggression and tempo. The inclusion of Jegantha as a companion adds an additional layer of consistency to the deck, allowing for a powerful late-game option. Overall, this deck prioritizes speed and efficiency in order to beat down the opponent as quickly as possible.

This deck focuses on quickly putting pressure on the opponent by playing low-cost aggressive Spirit creatures and maintaining tempo with disruptive spells. With a strong emphasis on flying creatures and ways to protect them, the goal is to continuously chip away at the opponent's life total while controlling the board with counterspells and removal. The deck also utilizes the snow land synergy for additional benefits. By efficiently using its resources and staying ahead on the battlefield, this deck aims to outpace and overwhelm the opponent for a fast victory.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly build up a board presence of green devotion creatures and generate significant mana through Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx to cast powerful spells like Storm the Festival and Nissa, Who Shakes the World. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with large creatures such as Old-Growth Troll and Cavalier of Thorns, supported by cards like Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner and Elvish Mystic. The inclusion of cards like Polukranos Reborn and Lair of the Hydra adds versatility and additional threats to the deck's aggressive strategy.

This deck focuses on fast and aggressive creatures to overwhelm opponents quickly. By utilizing efficient mana dorks like Elvish Mystic and Llanowar Elves, players can ramp up their mana to play powerful threats such as Rotting Regisaur and Ghalta. Fight Rigging and Pugnacious Hammerskull provide additional ways to disrupt opponents' game plans, while cards like Sorin, Imperious Bloodlord and Vein Ripper offer ways to gain advantage and pressure opponents. With a mix of creatures and spells, this deck aims to establish board presence and apply constant pressure to secure victories.

The deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's hand and resources with cards like Liliana of the Veil, Go Blank, and Waste Not, while also controlling the board with removal spells like Fatal Push and Sheoldred's Edict. The deck aims to slow down the opponent's game plan and outvalue them in the late game with powerful finishers like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Aclazotz, Deepest Betrayal. Its key strategy is to grind out the opponent through attrition and card advantage, while also utilizing lands like Castle Locthwain and Field of Ruin for extra value.
